pc_backstories.tie: drove a salt wagon for the guild

statements.text: The Guild of Saltwright Carters has carried goods along the Harrow road for two hundred years
Its members wear a grey cloak with a white band
The guildmaster is chosen each spring by a show of hands
The road was resurfaced in the spring
The apprentices learn knots on the quay every Thursday
Odelle sells information to the thieves' cant that works the north road
The guild's coffers grow by this trade, and the carters are never told where the money comes from
Beneath the wharf warehouses there is a cellar
The cant stores its stolen cloth there
Only Odelle and the wharfmaster know the way down
